articles.summary: Sable Offshore Corp. (“Sable,” or the “Company”) (NYSE: SOC) today announced its third quarter 2026 financial and operational results. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Achieved $154.4 million in total revenue in the third quarter of 2026, representing a 13% increase quarter over quarter. Ended the quarter with $38.0 million of cash and cash equivalents. Ended the quarter with 207,980,283 shares of Common Stock outstanding after selling 16,110,711 shares of Common Stock in our at-the-market (“ATM”) equity program for an average price of approximately $4.75 per share during the quarter. Third Quarter 2026 Operational Results Reported average daily net sales volumes of approximately 27 thousand net barrels of oil per day, representing a 29% increase quarter over quarter. Produced at an average rate of 795 gross barrels of oil per day, per well, throughout the quarter from an average of 37 wells per day.
